description: Price a whole shopping list or recipe in one call: up to 40 lines in plain words. Matches each line at each store separately, then totals the list at one named store, or finds the cheapest single store and any cheaper split across two or three stores. Each priced line has a storeUrl that opens the product at that store: give the user these links when they want to buy. Each line's label says how the product compares with the line: same_product, equivalent, or different (a closest match the user should check). Store totals cover only the lines that store prices like-for-like: each says itemsPriced, missingLines, closeMatchLines (closest matches, in no total) and complete, so never present a partial total as the full shop; sharedLines compares the leading stores on the lines they all price. Stores in pausedStores are in no total. Lines in unmatched are in no total; close_match_only lines carry candidates to offer the user. To hand the user a page with the list priced at every store, call create_list_page. Afterwards, offer to save the list to their MyGroceryPal account with save_shopping_list.

store.description: Price the whole list at this one store. Leave it out to find the cheapest store, or a cheaper split across two or three stores.
